glosses: To escape, especially forcefully or defiantly.

examples.text: They broke out of prison in the middle of the night.

glosses: To rescue someone or aid their escape as in sense 1.

examples.text: After Big Tony was sent to prison, his friends got together to break him out.

examples.text: Break out the bubbly and celebrate.

examples.text: Break out the cables from the harness once they are inside the frame.

examples.text: He broke out in sweat.
